title: The Principal Behind a Charge Owed on a Certificate of Deposit
content:
The principal a charge owed on a certificate of the Certificates of Deposit line is worked out on is measured against two things: the card the owner holds, and how steadily the certificate has been crediting interest.

## The measure

The principal the entry is worked out on is measured as follows: where the owner holds an active Piedmont Crescent card opened before the term began and interest was credited to the certificate in each of the 3 months before the entry is booked, it is the principal taken out by early partial withdrawals in those three months together with the interest credited in them; where the owner holds an active Piedmont Crescent card and either that card was opened after the term began or interest was credited in fewer than each of those 3 months, it is the principal taken out by early partial withdrawals in those three months less the interest credited in them; where the owner holds no active card, it is the principal taken out by early partial withdrawals in those three months.

## What is read

The card is an active account of the bank's Personal Credit Cards line belonging to the owner, and the day it was opened is set against the day the certificate's term began. The crediting counted is the interest credited to the certificate over the three months ending on the day the entry is booked, and the question asked of it is whether it fell in each of those 3 months or in fewer.

## Condition and result

| Active card held | Card opened before the term began | Months of those 3 in which interest was credited | The principal the entry is worked out on |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 3 | the sum taken out in those three months, together with the interest credited in them |
| yes | yes | fewer than 3 | the sum taken out, less the interest credited in them |
| yes | no | any | the sum taken out, less the interest credited in them |
| no | — | any | the sum taken out in those three months |

## Worked readings, on hypothetical figures

In the three months before the entry is booked, 6000.00 USD of principal was taken out by early partial withdrawals and 210.00 USD of interest was credited, in each of the three months.

| The owner's card | The principal the entry is worked out on |
|---|---|
| active, opened two years before the term began | 6210.00 USD |
| active, opened one month after the term began | 5790.00 USD |
| none held | 6000.00 USD |

Where the same owner held an active card opened before the term began but interest had been credited in only two of those three months, the second grade governs and the figure is 5790.00 USD.
